abilities.name: Rockstar
abilities.text: Using a Basic Ability grants 25 Armor for 2 seconds. Heroic Abilities grant 50 Armor.

abilities.name: Powerslide
abilities.text: Slide to a location dealing 105 damage and Stunning enemies hit for 1.25 seconds.

abilities.name: Face Melt
abilities.text: Deals 68 damage to nearby enemies, knocking them back.

abilities.name: Guitar Solo
abilities.text: Regenerate 66 Health per second for 4 seconds.

abilities.name: Mosh Pit
abilities.text: After 0.75 seconds, channel to stun nearby enemies for 4 seconds.

abilities.name: Stage Dive
abilities.text: Leap to target location, landing after 2.75 seconds, dealing 330 damage to enemies in the area, and slowing them by 50% for 4 seconds.

1.name: Guitar Hero
1.text: While Guitar Solo is active, E.T.C. heals for 60% of his damage dealt by Basic Attacks. Basic Attacks increase the duration of Guitar Solo by 0.5 seconds.

1.name: Prog Rock
1.text:
Quest: Gathering a Regeneration Globe permanently increases the healing per second of Guitar Solo by 5, to a maximum of 100

Reward: After gathering 20 Regeneration Globes, Guitar Solo also heals nearby allied Heroes for 50 Health every second while it is active.

1.name: Block Party
1.text: Using a Basic or Heroic ability also gives nearby allied Heroes a stack of Block, granting 75 Physical Armor against the next Hero Basic Attack for 8 seconds, reducing the damage taken by 75%. Maximum 2 stacks of Block.

4.name: Crowd Surfer
4.text: Allows Powerslide to travel over walls and terrain. If no enemies are hit, reduce the cooldown by 6 seconds and refund the Mana cost.

4.name: Loud Speakers
4.text: Increases Face Melt range and knockback by 50%.

4.name: Speed Metal
4.text: Using a Basic or Heroic ability also gives nearby allied Heroes 20% Movement Speed for 2.5 seconds.

7.name: Pinball Wizard
7.text: Hitting an enemy with Powerslide causes the next Face Melt against them within 2 seconds to deal 300% more damage.

7.name: Hammer-on
7.text: E.T.C.'s Basic Attacks deal 12% more damage, increased to 36% while Guitar Solo is active.

7.name: Echo Pedal
7.text: Using a Basic or Heroic Ability releases two pulses of 18 damage. This deals 200% bonus damage to Minions, Mercenaries, and Monsters. The first occurs instantly, the second occurs 2 seconds later.

10.name: Mosh Pit
10.text: After 0.75 seconds, channel to stun nearby enemies for 4 seconds.

10.name: Stage Dive
10.text: Leap to target location, landing after 2.75 seconds, dealing 330 damage to enemies in the area, and slowing them by 50% for 4 seconds.

13.name: Mic Check
13.text: Hitting at least 2 targets with Face Melt reduces its cooldown by 6 seconds.

13.name: Encore
13.text:
Face Melt leaves an Amp behind, which will knock enemies away again 2 seconds later.

Passive: Each enemy Hero hit by Face Melt or the Amp reduces your Heroic Ability cooldown by 4%.

13.name: Face Smelt
13.text: Face Melt Slows enemies by 50%, decaying over 2 seconds.

16.name: Show Stopper
16.text: After using Powerslide, gain 35 Armor for 4 seconds, reducing all damage taken by 35%.

16.name: Aggressive Shredding
16.text: E.T.C.'s Basic Attacks reduce the cooldown of Guitar Solo by 0.75 seconds.

16.name: Imposing Presence
16.text:
Activate to reduce the Attack Speed by 50% and Movement Speed by 20% of nearby Heroes and Summons for 2.5 seconds.

Passive: Heroes and Summons that attack your Hero have their Attack Speed Slowed by 20% for 2.5 seconds.

20.name: Tour Bus
20.text: Channeling Mosh Pit refreshes Powerslide's cooldown, and it can be cast to increase Mosh Pit's duration by 2 seconds.

20.name: Crowd Pleaser
20.text: Stage Dive's impact area is 50% bigger, and its Slow is increased by 30%.

20.name: Death Metal
20.text: Upon dying, a ghost uses Mosh Pit at E.T.C's location.

20.name: Power of the Horde
20.text: Activate to grant nearby allied Heroes a Shield that absorbs damage equal to 30% of their maximum Health for 5 seconds, increased by 2% for each other allied Hero in the area.

20.name: Ride the Lightning
20.text: Activate to teleport to a nearby location and deal 48 damage to nearby enemy Heroes. The cooldown is reduced by 10 second for every enemy Hero hit, up to 50 seconds.
